lines: 就如经上所记：没有义人，
连一个也没有。
As it is written
“There is no one righteous; no
not one.
就如经上所记：没有义人，
连一个也没有。
就如經上所記：沒有義人，
連一個也沒有。
As it is written
“There is no one righteous; no
not one.
As it is said in the holy Writings
There is not one who does righteousness;
我栽种了，亚波罗浇灌了，
惟有神叫他生长。
I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
我栽种了，亚波罗浇灌了，
惟有神叫他生长。
我栽種了，亞波羅澆灌了，
惟有神叫他生長。
I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
I did the planting
Apollos did the watering
but God gave the increase.
你们要靠主常常喜乐。我再说，
你们要喜乐。
Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say
“Rejoice!”
你们要靠主常常喜乐。我再说，
你们要喜乐。
你們要靠主常常喜樂。我再說，
你們要喜樂。
Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say
“Rejoice!”
Be glad in the Lord at all times: again I say
Be glad.
他赦免你的一切罪孽，
医治你的一切疾病。
who forgives all your sins; who heals all your diseases;
他赦免你的一切罪孽，
医治你的一切疾病。
他赦免你的一切罪孽，
醫治你的一切疾病。
who forgives all your sins; who heals all your diseases;
He has forgiveness for all your sins; he takes away all your diseases;
逼迫你们的，要给他们祝福；
只要祝福，不可咒诅。
Bless those who persecute you; bless
and don’t curse.
逼迫你们的，要给他们祝福；
只要祝福，不可咒诅。
逼迫你們的，要給他們祝福；
只要祝福，不可咒詛。
Bless those who persecute you; bless
and don’t curse.
Give blessing and not curses to those who are cruel to you.
与喜乐的人要同乐；
与哀哭的人要同哭。
Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
与喜乐的人要同乐；
与哀哭的人要同哭。
與喜樂的人要同樂；
與哀哭的人要同哭。
Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
Take part in the joy of those who are glad
and in the grief of those who are sorrowing.
你们不要自欺；滥交是败坏善行。
Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”
你们不要自欺；滥交是败坏善行。
你們不要自欺；濫交是敗壞善行。
Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”
Do not be tricked by false words: evil company does damage to good behaviour.
你们要慈悲，像你们的父慈悲一样。」
“Therefore be merciful
even as your Father is also merciful.
你们要慈悲，像你们的父慈悲一样。」
你們要慈悲，像你們的父慈悲一樣。」
“Therefore be merciful
even as your Father is also merciful.
Be full of pity
even as your Father is full of pity.
懒惰人哪，你去察看蚂蚁的动作就可得智慧。
Go to the ant
you sluggard. Consider her ways
and be wise;
懒惰人哪，你去察看蚂蚁的动作就可得智慧。
懶惰人哪，你去察看螞蟻的動作就可得智慧。
Go to the ant
you sluggard. Consider her ways
and be wise;
Go to the ant
you hater of work; give thought to her ways and be wise:
凡有气息的都要赞美耶和华！你们要赞美耶和华！
Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
凡有气息的都要赞美耶和华！你们要赞美耶和华！
凡有氣息的都要讚美耶和華！你們要讚美耶和華！
Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
Let everything which has breath give praise to the Lord. Let the Lord be praised.
你们要将一切的忧虑卸给神，
因为他顾念你们。
casting all your worries on him
because he cares for you.
你们要将一切的忧虑卸给神，
因为他顾念你们。
你們要將一切的憂慮卸給神，
因為他顧念你們。
casting all your worries on him
because he cares for you.
Putting all your troubles on him
for he takes care of you.
不要劳碌求富，休仗自己的聪明。
Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom
show restraint.
不要劳碌求富，休仗自己的聪明。
不要勞碌求富，休仗自己的聰明。
Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom
show restraint.
Take no care to get wealth; let there be an end to your desire for money.
你们要向耶和华唱新歌！全地都要向耶和华歌唱！
Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh
all the earth.
你们要向耶和华唱新歌！全地都要向耶和华歌唱！
你們要向耶和華唱新歌！全地都要向耶和華歌唱！
Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh
all the earth.
O make a new song to the Lord; let all the earth make melody to the Lord.
因为「凡求告主名的，
就必得救。」
For
“Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
因为「凡求告主名的，
就必得救。」
因為「凡求告主名的，
就必得救。」
For
“Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
Because
Whoever will give worship to the name of the Lord will get salvation.
他在万有之先；万有也靠他而立。
He is before all things
and in him all things are held together.
他在万有之先；万有也靠他而立。
他在萬有之先；萬有也靠他而立。
He is before all things
and in him all things are held together.
He is before all things
and in him all things have being.
你们作丈夫的，要爱你们的妻子，
不可苦待她们。
Husbands
love your wives
and don’t be bitter against them.
你们作丈夫的，要爱你们的妻子，
不可苦待她们。
你們作丈夫的，要愛你們的妻子，
不可苦待她們。
Husbands
love your wives
and don’t be bitter against them.
Husbands
have love for your wives
and be not bitter against them.
因为，你们的财宝在那里，
你们的心也在那里。」
For where your treasure is
there will your heart be also.
因为，你们的财宝在那里，
你们的心也在那里。」
因為，你們的財寶在那裏，
你們的心也在那裏。」
For where your treasure is
there will your heart be also.
For where your wealth is
there will your heart be.
你所作的，要交托耶和华，
你所谋的，就必成立。
Commit your deeds to Yahweh
and your plans shall succeed.
你所作的，要交托耶和华，
你所谋的，就必成立。
你所作的，要交託耶和華，
你所謀的，就必成立。
Commit your deeds to Yahweh
and your plans shall succeed.
Put your works into the hands of the Lord
and your purposes will be made certain.
我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！不可忘记他的一切恩惠！
Praise Yahweh
my soul
and don’t forget all his benefits;
我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！不可忘记他的一切恩惠！
我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！不可忘記他的一切恩惠！
Praise Yahweh
my soul
and don’t forget all his benefits;
Give praise to the Lord
O my soul; let not all his blessings go from your memory.
你们和我当称耶和华为大，
一同高举他的名。
Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let us exalt his name together.
你们和我当称耶和华为大，
一同高举他的名。
你們和我當稱耶和華為大，
一同高舉他的名。
Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let us exalt his name together.
O give praise to the Lord with me; let us be witnesses together of his great name.
